one_line: Kalachuri overlord of Kalyani who ruled during the Chalukya decline in mid-12th century Karnataka.

appearance.age_look: late 40s, medium-tall, solid broad-shouldered build with a commanding stance
appearance.face: oval face with a strong jaw, wheatish-brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed medium-length moustache, faint age lines at the eyes, default expression calm and calculating with a steady, assessing gaze
appearance.hair: thick, straight black hair pulled back into a short, neat knot at the back of the head; front kept tidy with no loose bangs; topped with a modest golden Kalyani-style cylindrical crown-band (mukut) hugging the head, set with small red and green stones
appearance.costume: He wears a mid-12th-century Deccan royal costume: a long-sleeved fitted upper tunic in deep maroon silk with subtle gold floral motifs, extending to mid-thigh; over it, a golden-yellow silk angavastra draped from left shoulder across chest and around the back in clean folds; his lower garment is a cream-coloured cotton dhoti wrapped tightly around the waist and legs, pleated in front and reaching the ankles, bordered with a narrow red and gold stripe; he has a broad, engraved gold waist-belt (mekhala) securing the dhoti, layered gold necklaces with small pendants, simple gold armlets on both upper arms, and several plain gold bangles; his ears bear medium-sized gold earrings; feet in brown leather sandals; overall look neat, structured and royal but not overly ornate.
appearance.signature: A single long straight Deccan sword (khadga) with a slightly broad blade, iron-grey with a simple brass hilt and short crossguard, carried sheathed at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings, his right hand resting lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Bijjala II appears as a late-40s wheatish-brown Kalachuri king with tied-back black hair, modest gold crown-band, maroon tunic, golden-yellow angavastra, cream dhoti, gold ornaments and sandals, carrying a sheathed Deccan sword at his left hip in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Bijjala II: a late-40s, medium-tall, broad-shouldered Kalachuri overlord from mid-12th-century Kalyani with an oval wheatish-brown face, strong jaw, sharp nose, neat medium moustache, and calm, calculating eyes. His black hair is pulled back into a short knot with no loose bangs, topped by a modest golden cylindrical crown-band set with tiny red and green stones. He wears a deep maroon long-sleeved fitted tunic with subtle gold floral motifs reaching mid-thigh, a golden-yellow silk angavastra draped from his left shoulder across the chest and around his back in orderly folds, and a cream cotton dhoti wrapped tightly to the ankles with front pleats and a narrow red-and-gold border. A broad engraved gold waist-belt secures the dhoti; layered gold necklaces, gold armlets on both upper arms, simple gold bangles, and medium gold earrings complete his dignified royal jewelry. His feet are in brown leather sandals. At his left hip is his signature long straight Deccan sword with an iron-grey blade and simple brass hilt, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings, his right hand resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by maroon, golden yellow, cream, brown, and black, and show front, side, and three-quarter views to emphasize consistent face, hair, garments, and weapon details.
